purpose: Teach: ハイブリッド/ハンセン病/要塞/点字/沸騰/磁石/ワイヤー/リフト

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがハイブリッド車を試乗されたぞ
lines.en: You know, Gran, when your father was young, he test-drove a hybrid car.
lines.style: Gentle, distant recollection. Soft opening. Warm nostalgia without sentimentality. Slow thoughtful pace. Eyes looking back in time, not seeking confirmation.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ハンセン病療養所の見学に行かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Mm-hmm. And you visited that Hansen's disease sanatorium back then, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Soft, knowing smile in the voice. Turning the memory-game back on him with affection. Patient, slightly teasing. The warmth of someone who knows him completely.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがお城の要塞を訪ねられたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he visited an old castle fortress.
lines.style: Same gentle distance as before. Offering another piece of the past. Unhurried. Almost as if speaking to himself, but including her.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、点字図書を読まれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you used to read those braille books, didn't you, love?
lines.style: Turning back to him again. Tender but firm — a gentle reminder, a quiet acknowledgment of what he did. The sound of long-shared history.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが薬缶を沸騰させてお茶を入れて下さったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he'd boil the kettle and make tea for everyone.
lines.style: Softer now. The memory touching something deeper. Quieter attack. Lingering on the image of the kettle. Trailing into gratitude.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、磁石の実験を孫に見せてらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you showed our grandchildren those magnet experiments, remember? You were so proud.
lines.style: Warmth rising slightly. Recognition of his kindness to the children. Not a question really — a loving reminder. Steady, present voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがワイヤーで網を編まれたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he'd weave wire nets with his own hands.
lines.style: The voice grows smaller, more intimate. The skill, the patience of it sinking in. Almost wondering. Very slow. Breath between clauses.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、温泉旅行でリフトに乗られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you rode that cable car at the hot spring with me, didn't you, dear? I'll never forget that.
lines.style: Close, intimate. The memory vivid and precious. Slight catch of emotion held back. Gentle but unmistakably present. Eyes meeting his across decades.
